decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 20 July 2005, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 3.6m deep by 6.1m wide by 2.8m high was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development exceeds the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the single storey rear extension would be located closer to the highway than the part of the original dwellinghouse nearest to the highway, and less than 20m from the highway. The highway referred to is the Adopted Area Footway located adjacent to the rear of the site. The development therefore does not comply with part (c, i) of Class A of the above legislation.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to house
